claim: At narrow widths reuse the operator console navigation as a compact top bar with a section disclosure, then measure document overflow and verify accessible destination parity.

decisions.notes: The earlier console measured 621 pixels at a 375-pixel viewport while Workspace fit. The mobile implementation was reported to fit; do not equate layout screenshots with native touch, keyboard, zoom, or screen reader qualification. Keep scrolling local to wide tables.
